Saint Lucia Citizenship by Investment | What You Need to Know

Saint Lucia’s citizenship by investment program provides a legal route for citizenship. The primary requirement is an approved financial contribution in an approved option.

The program provides several benefits, subject to applicable destination-specific entry rules. Approved applicants can access a range of destinations with visa-free or visa-on-arrival entry.

Saint Lucia launched its citizenship-by-investment program in 2015. In a short time, it has become a competitive options for quaifying investors seeking a second passport. If you’re considering a second citizenship, Saint Lucia could be the option.

How to Get Saint Lucia Citizenship

The application process has five major stages:

  1. Documentation
  2. Due diligence
  3. Government review
  4. Investment fulfillment
  5. Registration

Saint Lucia law doesn’t require applicants to travel to the country at any stage. A registered Authorized Agent must submit the application on your behalf.

Step 1: Choosing investment route

Saint Lucia offers four approved investment routes.

  • National Economic Fund (NEF)

The National Economic Fund is the donation/contribution route. The applicant makes a non-refundable contribution to Saint Lucia’s NEF.

The minimum investment for qualifying investors is:

  • Applicants with up to 3 qualifying dependants: US$240,000
  • Each additional dependant under 18: US$10,000
  • Each additional dependant over 18: US$20,000

The investment is made after the application is approved. Applicants also pay separate government processing and due diligence fees. Due diligence is conducted on applicants aged 16.

  • Approved Real Estate Projects

The real estate route requires the applicant to purchase an interest in a government-approved real estate project. The minimum investment is US$300,000, plus applicable administration fees.

The program describes qualifying projects as including:

  • High-end branded hotels and resorts
  • High-end boutique properties

The investor receives title to the property as described in the program

  • Approved Enterprise Projects

The program allows investment in government-approved enterprise projects. The categories include:

  • Cruise ports and marinas
  • Agro-processing plants
  • Pharmaceutical products
  • Ports, bridges, roads and highways
  • Research institutions and facilities
  • Offshore universities
  • Housing projects
  • Investment services

There are 3 investment options:

  • Individual investor: US$3.5 million minimum investment
  • Joint investment: US$6 million minimum investment (each investor must contribute at least US$1,000,000)
  • Specialized Enterprise projects: US$250,000 minimum investment for an applicant with up to 3 qualifying dependants. (Note: This is a specialized tier subject to specific program conditions).
  • National Action Government Bonds (NAB)

Applicants can invest US$300,000 in non-interest-bearing National Action Government Bonds. The bond must remain registered in the applicant’s name for 5 years. A non-refundable US$50,000 administration fee also applies.

Step 2: Preliminary due diligence

Your authorized agent reviews your background before submitting the application. This step helps identify documentation or eligibility issues.

For this reason, engaging a professional registered agent is essential. The agent conducts preliminary checks and prepares your application for formal submission. Applicants must go through a licensed Authorized Agent.

Step 3: Document preparation

Your agent provides a list of essential documents. You submit the required materials, which the agent then authenticates and prepares for submission. Where documents are not in English, they must be translated.

Applicants must provide accurate information, completing mandatory forms, and cooperating throughout the process.

Step 4: Submit the application

The application is formally submitted to Saint Lucia’s Citizenship by Investment Unit. The CIU conducts its own background checks. The whole process of approval can take 18-24 months.

Applications are also subject to an interview and identity-verification process. This requirement applies to all applications received for processing.

Step 5: Make the investment

After the approval of your application, you’re instructed to fulfill the selected investment requirement. This depends on the route you choose.

The applicable total cost varies based on the investment route chosen and the number of dependants included in your application.

Step 6: Receive your passport

After you are granted citizenship, Saint Lucia issues a Certificate of Registration. You must then complete the required oath or affirmation of allegiance. Your agent can subsequently apply to the Immigration Department for your Saint Lucian passport.

Saint Lucia Passport Visa-Free Countries

Saint Lucian passport holders have access to a range of international destinations. This depends on each destination’s entry rules. Entry conditions can change. Applicants should verify current requirements before planning travel.

Europe

If you’ve a Saint Lucian passport, you can visit the Schengen Area visa-free for a short stay. The destinations include, but are not limited to, France, Germany, Italy, Spain, Portugal, and the Netherlands.

You can stay for up to 90 days within any 180-day period. Access depends on each country’s entry rules.

United Kingdom

You need a visa to visit the UK, even if you have a Saint Lucia passport. The UK introduced a visit visa requirement for Saint Lucian nationals on March 5, 2026. Applicants should verify current requirements before traveling.

Caribbean and Beyond

The Saint Lucian passport provides a visa-free or visa-on-arrival access to several destinations across the Caribbean, Africa, and parts of Asia. Entry conditions can vary and depend on the country you’re to visit.

What about the USA?

Saint Lucian citizens require a visa to enter the US. U.S. entry requirements and visa issuance policies are subject to U.S. law and may change at any time.

Applicants should review the current requirements published by the U.S. Department of State before making travel plans.

Saint Lucia Citizenship Requirements

Key eligibility requirements generally include the following:

Personal requirements

  • You must be at least 18 years old
  • You must pass the program’s due diligence checks
  • Your funds and wealth must be legitimate and verifiable
  • You must provide full and frank disclosure and comply with the program’s application requirements

Investment requirements

The Saint Lucia citizenship by investment cost depends on which route you choose and how many eligible dependants are included.

Option 1: National Economic Fund (NEF) Contribution

  • Applicant with up to three qualifying dependants: US$240,000
  • Each additional qualifying dependant under 18: US$10,000
  • Each additional qualifying dependant over 18: US$20,000

Option 2: Real Estate Investment

  • Minimum investment: US$300,000 in an approved real estate project
  • Applicable administration fees also apply
  • A holding period of at least 5 years

Option 3: Enterprise Project

  • Individual applicant: US$3,500,000 minimum investment in a standard enterprise project.
  • Joint investment: US$6,000,000 minimum investment with each applicant contributing at least US$1,000,000
  • Specialized Enterprise Option: US$250,000 minimum investment. This option covers an applicant and up to 3 qualifying dependants, subject to program conditions.
  • Non-refundable administrative and processing fees also apply based on the application.

Option 4: National Action Bond

  • Minimum investment in government bonds: US$300,000
  • An additional, non-refundable fee of US$50,000
  • A five-year holding period

Documents you’ll need

  • Valid passport from your country of origin
  • Certified birth certificate
  • Police or other background documentation
  • Medical certificate and other medical documentation
  • Bank statements and supporting evidence for source of funds
  • Passport-size photographs
  • Marriage certificate (if applicable)
  • Proof of residential address

Documents not in English must include an authenticated English translation. The original or certified supporting documents are required.

One important note: Saint Lucia permits dual citizenship. The citizenship by investment program does not require giving up the existing nationality.

How Long Does Saint Lucia Citizenship Take?

Application approval takes 18-24 months. This includes time required for investment fulfillment, the oath or affirmation of allegiance, and passport issuance.

Processing times can vary depending on the completeness of the application and due diligence requirements.

Here’s a general timeline:

  • CIU due diligence: The CIU conducts due diligence through law enforcement and third-party firms. Applicants aged 16 and older are subject to due diligence and may be required to provide additional information or attend an interview.
  • Application review and approval: After completing its assessment, the CIU prepares a report and recommendation for the Citizenship by Investment Board, which may grant, deny, or delay the application.
  • Certificate of Registration (COR): Once citizenship is granted, the CIP Unit issues the applicant’s Certificate of Registration.
  • NIC process: The new citizen can then complete the National Identification Card process, which is relevant for passport applications for applicants aged 18 and over.
  • Passport: After the Certificate of Registration is issued, the Authorised Agent applies to the Immigration Department for the Saint Lucian passport.

Saint Lucian citizenship process is slow and can take 18-24 months to complete.

Is Saint Lucia a Good Investment Passport?

Yes. For many qualifying investors, Saint Lucia is a competitive second passport option. With a Saint Lucia passport, you can visit a range of international destinations, subject to each country’s entry rules.

You can complete the application process without establishing physical residence in Saint Lucia. You can include eligible dependants in a single application.

Who can you include as dependants?

Eligible dependants may include the following categories, subject to the program’s qualifying requirements:

  • Your spouse
  • Children over 21 or below
  • Dependant children up to age 30
  • Children of any age who are physically or mentally challenged
  • Unmarried siblings below 18, financially dependent on you
  • Parents over 55 whom you fully support
  • Parents of any age who are physically or mentally challenged

Limitations to consider

Saint Lucia does not include the US in visa-free destinations. Saint Lucian nationals also now require a visa to visit the United Kingdom. Tax treatment for Saint Lucian citizens or residents should be assessed based on individual circumstances.

Final Thoughts

Saint Lucia’s citizenship by investment program allows you to visit Europe. But you need a visa to visit the US and the UK. You can include eligible family members in the same application. You’re also allowed to keep your existing citizenship.

The process is structured. The requirements are clearly defined. A dedicated government unit administers the program with an established track record.

For qualifying investors seeking a second citizenship, Saint Lucia’s citizenship-by-investment program offers a legal pathway with multiple investment options.
